scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && pnpm db:up && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.dev: pnpm db:up && pnpm db:migrate && concurrently -k -n gateway,metering,api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green,yellow,cyan "pnpm --filter @callosum/mocks gateway" "pnpm --filter @callosum/mocks metering" "pnpm --filter @callosum/server api" "pnpm --filter @callosum/server worker" "pnpm --filter @callosum/web dev"
